proofs.title: Actual adjacent-rank transport
proofs.proved_scope: Integral finite gluing, exact jet/level cancellation, joint level invariance and transported marked-prime charge.
proofs.remaining_boundary: Full analytic datum and exceptional arithmetic corrections remain.
proofs.internal_review: Root independently checked the actual Hom-chain, auxiliary level, restricted adjoint and integral coordinates.

proofs.title: Definite-chain norm budget
proofs.proved_scope: Short Gram/intermediate-module class count and actual all-conjugate error at most 108 f a log b, or 109 for the indicated terminal class norm.
proofs.remaining_boundary: This upper-chain theorem is not the general product-form comparison norm theorem.
proofs.internal_review: Root and a separate internal reviewer checked genus counting, the fixed vacuum constant and every original-scale cost.

proofs.title: Six-copy sharp test
proofs.proved_scope: Integral monomial contraction, vacuum cancellation, class-period identity and actual rank-one test-form condition for blocks (6,4,4,2z-14); Fourier exponent 6f.
proofs.remaining_boundary: Critical projection budgets and the general comparison gluing remain separate.
proofs.internal_review: Root checked Gram, phases, class weights, residual rank and the rank-one period interface.

proofs.title: Rank-one false-lift periods
proofs.proved_scope: Two-orbit bottom, first-occurrence tower vanishing, uniform-moderate-growth rapid decay, exact Fourier period detector and kernel absorption; range n>2A+5.
proofs.remaining_boundary: No general-rank bottom or higher-rank product-form gluing-period theorem is claimed.
proofs.internal_review: Root and two separate internal reviewers checked the Hecke orientation, analytic boundedness, good-place fibres, dyadic transitivity, character cancellation and source-space continuity.

proofs.title: Direct Bessel good-type transfer
proofs.proved_scope: Mirabolic generic multiplicity, exact induced-Bessel mass and actual class trace, bad share at most 2 b^-9 per prime, and convolution compression of the two strip estimates.
proofs.remaining_boundary: The analytic restricted strips remain hypotheses.
proofs.internal_review: Root and a separate internal reviewer checked the Andrews-Thiem hypotheses, local hook length, actual trace and right-convolution orientation.

proofs.title: Rank-two analytic endpoint
proofs.proved_scope: Equal-rank constancy, convergent anisotropic Siegel-Weil, exact local integrals and fully ramified period norm; the initial period is nonzero.
proofs.remaining_boundary: Imprimitive Euler insertion can vanish; no arbitrary period is declared nonzero.
proofs.internal_review: Root and a separate internal reviewer checked the transpose character, strong/weak approximation roles, Yamana hypotheses, Haar factors, Cartan integrals and functional equation.

proofs.title: Weighted lattice mean
proofs.proved_scope: The exact weighted class-lattice average with N^(-kf) gain, using complementary Gram determinants, Minkowski, local zeta sums and row averaging.
proofs.remaining_boundary: Analytic orbit integrals are not consequences of this count.
proofs.internal_review: Root and a separate internal reviewer checked projective modules, annihilator rows, Haar class averaging and all exponent absorptions.

proofs.title: Three-quotient frame fibres
proofs.proved_scope: Explicit integral moves and three finite quotient counts; combined with the lattice mean, the full weighted pair count in the stated cell, corank and discriminant range.
proofs.remaining_boundary: Reduction of all analytic terms to the specified cell family remains separate.
proofs.internal_review: Root and a separate internal reviewer checked the reciprocal basis-scale convention, Gram-colour lift, last-column norm, skew solution, fixed-label separation and common-link fullness.

proofs.title: Congruence and reciprocal-index gains
proofs.proved_scope: Positive link graphs, coranks, common-link fullness, congruence determinant gain, torsion-index cancellation and actual near-gauge bound. The exact pair gain and its range follow conditionally from cut (15).
proofs.remaining_boundary: Integral complementary-lattice construction and the precise cut (15), including meet-norm improvement, remain open.
proofs.internal_review: Root and a separate internal reviewer checked the finite quotient map, projective determinant normalization, actual gauge, row-index truncation and conditional range.

proofs.title: One shared restricted-moment reduction
proofs.proved_scope: Complete summation and original-scale arithmetic: the remaining geometric package gives both strips <=9 b^-40 |R| dim X and source deficit <=5 b^-9 dim X.
proofs.remaining_boundary: The integral link-lattice cut, gauge-specific orbit estimate and zero-term reduction remain hypotheses; no full restricted moment is claimed.
proofs.internal_review: Root checked the dimension factor in the Hilbert-Schmidt cutoff tail and the exact shared-strip exponents; an independent review checked the pair-count and gain interfaces.

proofs.title: Exact crystalline loss and aggregate budget
proofs.proved_scope: Actual cyclotomic obstruction min(n,a_p N+v_p(N!)), sparse cyclotomic-inertia certificate, and the exact weighted aggregate projection inequality sufficient for the determinant.
proofs.remaining_boundary: The effective growing-field nonabelian budget is open; Hodge weights alone do not prove cyclotomic inertia.
proofs.internal_review: Root and a separate internal reviewer checked unsaturated lattices, universal extensions, trivial finite local classes, coefficient normalization and the signed aggregate budget.
